label: Augustine of Hippo, De civitate Dei… supports A move that affirms that God can be known…
note: Patristic usage, and the closest to the bridge: pagan philosophers reached an unchangeable first principle by reasoning from changeable things, which Augustine reads with Rom 1:20. Gap: Augustine also says God showed it to them, and he speaks of the Platonists, not of all; the step from their success to a standard shared by outsiders as such is the reading.
